findings.cause: watch.expires_at applies next_day_boundary POI_MAX_AGE_TRADING_DAYS + 1 times, which counts Saturday and Sunday. The helper that implements the declared unit (_poi_age_days, distinct NY-17:00 trading dates) exists in the same file and is never called.

evidence.implemented: watch.expires_at: POI_MAX_AGE_TRADING_DAYS + 1 applications of next_day_boundary = 6 consecutive CALENDAR NY-17:00 dates from the POI origin
evidence.materiality: Conservative direction, MEASURED not assumed: every divergent origin on every calendar is ENGINE_EXPIRES_EARLIER (see `directions`), because the trading-date set is a subset of the calendar-date set, so six calendar boundaries land at or before six trading dates. The engine therefore suppresses POI life -- it can drop an opportunity or hold a state at NEAR_POI/DEVELOPING -- but it never keeps a POI alive longer than the contract allows. No ENGINE_EXPIRES_LATER origin exists.
evidence.scope: FX instruments only: BTCUSD/ETHUSD trade every calendar date on this venue, so both clocks coincide there (measured above). EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY/XAUUSD lose trading-day life whenever the FX weekend falls inside the 5-day window.

findings.headline: POI max age is declared in TRADING days and implemented in CALENDAR NY-17:00 dates

poi_age_semantics.implemented_rule: watch.expires_at: POI_MAX_AGE_TRADING_DAYS + 1 applications of next_day_boundary = 6 consecutive CALENDAR NY-17:00 dates from the POI origin
poi_age_semantics.materiality: Conservative direction, MEASURED not assumed: every divergent origin on every calendar is ENGINE_EXPIRES_EARLIER (see `directions`), because the trading-date set is a subset of the calendar-date set, so six calendar boundaries land at or before six trading dates. The engine therefore suppresses POI life -- it can drop an opportunity or hold a state at NEAR_POI/DEVELOPING -- but it never keeps a POI alive longer than the contract allows. No ENGINE_EXPIRES_LATER origin exists.
poi_age_semantics.scope: FX instruments only: BTCUSD/ETHUSD trade every calendar date on this venue, so both clocks coincide there (measured above). EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY/XAUUSD lose trading-day life whenever the FX weekend falls inside the 5-day window.

window_sensitivity.note: Recorded, not gated: bias/POI/opportunity are window-dependent by construction (the host supplies fixed rolling counts). C15/C16 report the same effect as separate short_d1 and full_d1 lanes; a shorter D1/H1 window can change which POI or opportunity is selected.

reproducibility: byte-reproducible: no wall-clock field, no run id, no hostname; fixed rng seed 20261013. The only run-dependent value is identity.code_sha = `git rev-parse HEAD` resolved at import (v1_tickets.code_identity), so two runs on the same commit are byte-identical; every other hash is over working-tree bytes actually exercised.
